metadata.description: Prose fluency for any AI agent. Catch robotic-sounding writing and rewrite it in a voice you choose.

plugins.name: cadence
plugins.description: Catch robotic-sounding writing and rewrite it in a voice you choose. One skill, 5 commands (/cadence write, learn, recast, deslop, voices) and a deterministic checker that scores prose and names every tell.

plugins.name: readme-auto-update
plugins.description: Create and refresh evidence-based GitHub profile or project READMEs from repository activity, with free structural templates (icons, badges, table, and more) — no agent or API key. Pairs with Cadence to humanize the prose.
